displayDescription.en:
Gradient-boosted trees were highly accurate, but large datasets and sparse features exposed systems bottlenecks. XGBoost combined a regularized objective with an engineering design built for scalable parallel and out-of-core learning.

The system uses second-order gradient statistics, regularized tree scoring, sparsity-aware split finding, column blocks, and cache-conscious computation. These choices make boosted trees efficient across machines and data formats. Experts generally regard XGBoost as the system that made gradient-boosted trees a default high-performance tool for tabular prediction. Its open-source ecosystem and competition success drove broad industrial adoption.
displayDescription.zh:
梯度提升树精度很高，但大规模数据和稀疏特征暴露出系统瓶颈。XGBoost 把正则化目标与面向并行和外存学习的工程设计结合起来。

系统使用二阶梯度统计、正则化树评分、稀疏感知划分搜索、列块和缓存友好计算。这些设计使提升树能在不同机器和数据格式上高效运行。专家通常把 XGBoost 视为使梯度提升树成为表格预测默认高性能工具的关键系统。其开源生态和竞赛表现推动了广泛工业应用。
